app.name: Go Interview Quiz
app.description: Interactive Go (Golang) interview questions with explanations for every option and links to the sources.

quiz.pick: Pick an answer to see the explanation.
quiz.shortcuts: Keys: 1–5 or A–E to answer, Enter for the next question.
quiz.why_wrong: Why the other options are wrong
quiz.finished: You answered every question in this selection.
quiz.finished_text: Change the difficulties, redo your wrong answers from Review, or reset your progress in Settings.

history.title: History
history.intro: One entry per quiz run on this device: a run ends when you finish the selection or reset your progress.
history.empty: No runs yet. Answer a question to start one.
history.clear_confirm: Delete every saved run? Your current progress is kept.

review.title: Review
review.intro: Questions you answered wrong in this browser session. Redo them until each one is right; a question leaves the list once you get it right.
review.empty: Nothing to review: no wrong answers in this session.
review.done_text: Exit review to continue the quiz where you left off.
